reason: The user requested stopping because the computer became sluggish.

environment.backgroundActivity: Normal desktop use continued. Browser, messaging and editor processes were active at the recorded snapshot; repository builds and lightweight checks also ran during this soak. No second model benchmark was run concurrently.

soak.scope: Repeated synthetic Japanese audio; precomputed real Silero probabilities replayed at real-time pace through segmentation, ASR and translation. Excludes live VAD computation, browser/microphone, diverse streams and Chinese speech.
soak.fatal: Stopped at user request because the computer became sluggish.
